properties.name: picsure.operations.internal-token
properties.description: Shared secret that InternalTokenFilter requires on the X-PIC-SURE-INTERNAL-TOKEN header for every /internal/** request. Maps from the QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN environment variable. Fail-closed: when blank, every /internal/** request is rejected with 403, even one carrying a header value.

properties.name: picsure.operations.dataset-bring-over.enabled
properties.description: Whether a read of named datasets files the caller's datasets under the general query of their stored query. A dataset saved before query rows had owners points at a row with no owner and lists no variants. When true, a list or read by its user derives the general query id from the dataset's stored query and the user, stores that general query if it is not stored yet, and writes it on the dataset. No query row is stored or changed and the dataset's queryId stays as it is, so a stack without general queries reads the dataset as before. When false, a dataset read writes nothing.
